sinopsis.es: Iván se enamora de Hadoum en el invernadero donde trabajan. Sin embargo, su anhelado ascenso laboral interfiere en la relación, obligándole a decidir qué tipo de hombre quiere ser.
sinopsis.en: Iván (33), a trans man, and Hadoum (30), a Spanish-Moroccan woman, fall in love at the industrial greenhouse they work in. While facing the opposition from their families and co-workers, Iván realizes he doesn’t need to be the man he is expected to be.
